title: A ring buffer of the last N prices
hints: Keep `capacity_`, `count_` (≤ capacity) and `head_` (where the next push goes) plus a `double*` buffer.
The oldest element is at `(head_ + capacity_ - count_) % capacity_`; `at(i)` adds `i` to that, modulo capacity.
It owns memory, so write the rule of three: destructor, deep copy, copy-and-swap assignment.
